item.title: Lilienthal
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dollhouse
  • 発売日: 1999-07-15
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: リリエンタール
  • 英語名: Lilienthal

あらすじ

The city of the Valley of Dragons… Lilienthal. The stories of three protagonists start here.

Brad is a boy who lives with his pet animal Lulu in a secluded castle.

Chris is a male student of a medieval university who is sexually harassed by the girls around him.

Claris is a daughter of the king and is in search of medicine to cure the king.

item.title: V ZONE
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dollhouse
  • 発売日: 1995-02-10
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ＶＺＯＮＥ
  • 英語名: V ZONE

あらすじ

The protagonist bought 5 highly priced special adult VHS and found he could enter the VHS world acting as the main character of each VHS himself. During the exploration of the VHS world the protagonist realizes that all the characters are linked, so he must find clues related to each title and push the story of each title to the very end.
